observations: Three photos show a PS4 game case for NBA 2K20.
The case is blue with the PS4 logo at the top.
The cover art features Anthony Davis with the text 'ANTHONY DAVIS' and 'NBA 2K20' prominently displayed.
The ESRB rating 'E' for Everyone is visible in the bottom left corner.
A yellow sticker with '3' is taped to the front cover in photo 0 and photo 1.
A white sticker with 'N872204530' is visible on the front cover in photo 0 and photo 1.
The case appears to be in good physical condition with no visible cracks or damage.
The background shows a room with a 'Prezin' sign and a TV, suggesting a retail or gaming environment.

claims.claim: NBA 2K20 is a highly popular basketball simulation video game developed by Visual Concepts
claims.evidence: The game title and PS4 logo are visible, but the developer 'Visual Concepts' is not readable on the cover. The claim about popularity is subjective and not verifiable from photos.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The game may be a counterfeit or unauthorized copy.
risks.proof: A close-up of the barcode and serial number on the back of the case, or a scan of the game's digital code.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially counterfeit, which would reduce value significantly

risks.risk: The game may be missing accessories (e.g., controller, manual, or disc).
risks.proof: A photo showing the back of the case with all included items listed and visible.
risks.if_unproven: priced as missing accessories, which would reduce value

risks.risk: The game may be damaged or have scratches not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A photo of the inside of the case showing the disc and any scratches or damage.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly damaged, which would reduce value

proof_requests: A photo of the back of the game case showing the barcode and serial number.
A photo of the inside of the case showing the disc and any scratches or damage.
A photo of the included accessories (if any) laid out clearly.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
